title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00116 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
03:30 - 03:45: Performed TBT for skidding rig
03:45 - 04:00: Skidded cantilever to well f-1 c
04:00 - 04:45: Performed post-skid checks. Removed hatch in moonpool built scaffolding in moonpool and WH decks.
04:45 - 05:00: R/u hoses for displacing riser to SW
05:00 - 05:15: Lowered down and n/u nt2 connector
05:15 - 06:15: P/u and m/u cutter BHA and inner string. Inspected and cleaned threads on RT.
06:15 - 07:00: Engaged RT to multibowl. Took 20 ton overpull to confirm. M/u TDS
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT to n/d tension system.
07:15 - 07:30: Load shifted weight from tension cylinders to TDS. Observed to increased weight on weight indicator.
07:30 - 08:15: Discussed plan ahead.
08:15 - 10:00: Displaced riser to SW by pumping 10 m3 SW at 100 LPM, return seen after 7 m3 pumped. Meanwhile prepared to r/d tension cylinders.
10:00 - 10:45: R/d tension cylinders and boat collision stool. Meanwhile prepared to pull multibowl to drill floor.
10:45 - 11:00: Pulled 20 ton overpull. R/u return hoses to WH, secured same.
11:00 - 12:00: Staged up flow rate to 2400 LPM 87 bar. Cut riser at 134,9m.
12:00 - 12:30: R/d return hoses and valve outlets from multibowl.
12:30 - 13:00: POOH with inner string and riser to drill floor. Disengaged multibowl RT and r/b same in PRS.
13:00 - 13:45: R/u false rotary. POOH and r/b inner string and cutter BHA.
13:45 - 14:00: P/u and m/u multibowl RT.
14:00 - 14:45: POOH with riser, cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. Performed TBT for l/o multibowl and tensioner joint.
14:45 - 17:00: R/u cutting machine cut riser. Significant wave height 1,8m. R/d cutting machine
17:00 - 18:00: L/o multibowl and tensioner joint. R/d nt2 connector and multibowl RT. Meanwhile removed BX-ELEVATOR.
18:00 - 18:15: POOH with riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck.
18:15 - 19:00: M/u cutting machine cut riser. Significant wave height 1,9 m. R/d cutting machine
